app_chosen.description: The adapter's raw app_id choice (string), ONLY if it resolved to a real roster entry; null whenever fallback_used is true (an unknown/adversarial choice is never surfaced as if it were valid). No 'type' constraint here deliberately — the validator does not support union types (string|null); see teacher/mission_tasks precedent.

skill_dispatched.description: The skill_id actually dispatched — either the chosen app's own wrapper skill, or 'brain_think' on fallback.

fallback_used.description: true iff the adapter's app_id did not resolve to a known roster entry and brain_think was used instead (H-O3).

reasoning.description: The adapter's one-sentence explanation for its choice (or empty if it returned none).

result.description: The dispatched wrapper skill's own output, unchanged.
